title: The Danger of Running Sanitary Tees Horizontally
description: Using a standard sanitary tee in a horizontal-to-horizontal waste pipe transition is a common installation mistake. Sanitary tees are designed primarily for vertical-to-horizontal transitions or vent connections. When installed horizontally, the sharp sweep radius disrupts waste flow velocity and allows solids to collect at the junction, leading to persistent drain clogs. Plumbing codes require directional sweep fittings, such as a combination wye and eighth bend or a long-turn wye, to maintain smooth gravity flow along horizontal drain lines.

The Danger of Running Sanitary Tees Horizontally

Using a standard sanitary tee in a horizontal-to-horizontal waste pipe transition is a common installation mistake. Sanitary tees are designed primarily for vertical-to-horizontal transitions or vent connections. When installed horizontally, the sharp sweep radius disrupts waste flow velocity and allows solids to collect at the junction, leading to persistent drain clogs. Plumbing codes require directional sweep fittings, such as a combination wye and eighth bend or a long-turn wye, to maintain smooth gravity flow along horizontal drain lines.
